estimates: 66 kg running empty mass includes the source 114.9 lb robot and 17.9 lb bumpers plus an estimated 5.8 kg battery; diagonal inertia is approximate.

50 full-size 150 mm spheres with only one intake open; fitted to the measured recessed bowl, clipped raised platform, circular roof opening and actual feeder package. Flexible net floor remains estimated. Not an official capacity claim.
10.0584 m/s² powered acceleration and grip 1.05 are estimates; source 25 m/s² is a command limit. Optional Icarus-only wheel braking is estimated at 20.1168 m/s² and preserves powered acceleration.
12 shots/s, 38 fuel/s total, 5 rad/s turret response and .28 s feed transit are simulation estimates.
Per-shot angular/speed uncertainty and moving rating .90 are gameplay estimates, not TBA/Statbotics-derived hit probabilities.
Hopper restitution .22, friction .15 and linear damping .35/s are gameplay estimates; fuel/chassis mass unchanged.
limits: Side selection is manual/rebindable N (default controller button 3), not the real robot autonomous leading-side selection. A switch is refused above the shared eight-fuel compact packing limit; both sides never open together.
Managed dye-rotor feed path, not detailed hook/roller contact physics.
No supported climb profile established for final CAD; disabled despite retained code constants.

Opaque SRPP is faithful to the source; modeled nets are incomplete and the envelope is approximate; decals and small hardware are omitted. The embossed outer foam is replaced by four measured plain padding bars; actual backer/frame/mechanisms remain.
Exact Championship STEP / July GLB geometry equivalence is unverified.
